channel.title: Evgeny Redekop
channel.description: Findings and working notes on Josephson-junction arrays, nanoSQUID-on-tip microscopy, and human-in-the-loop AI for physics analysis.

item.title: How well do frontier AI models analyze measurement data?
item.description: I tested six frontier models on a real, open-ended analysis task from my lab: 16 datasets, four measurement campaigns, one Josephson junction array, no answer key.
